verdict: Search spend is generating clicks but almost no leads — only 2 leads recorded this period against $4,569 spent.
diagnosis: Cost per lead sits at roughly $2,285 this period, far above the $57 benchmark for medical practices, signaling a tracking or conversion breakdown.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads on $4,569 spend
signals.detail: Just 2 leads captured this period despite 1,797 clicks. Either conversion tracking is broken or the landing page is failing.

signals.headline: 1 call click from Google profile
signals.detail: The Google Business Profile drove just 1 call click in 28 days for a call-focused campaign. Local presence is underperforming.

signals.headline: 138 landing page views, 22 add-to-carts
signals.detail: Only 8% of landing page visitors added to cart. The page is losing most of the traffic ads paid to bring in.

signals.headline: 103 direction requests logged
signals.detail: Direction requests are the strongest local signal this period. Foot traffic intent exists even as phone calls do not.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897
signals.detail: A small purchase count produced meaningful revenue this period. Purchase value averages roughly $655, worth protecting.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Physician and surgeon Google Ads campaigns average a $57 cost per lead in 2026, with an 11.6% conversion rate. Broader healthcare cost per lead ranges from $25 to $80 for most practices.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Summer traditionally slows senior-targeted response, with families traveling and adult-child buyers deferring decisions. Purchase intent among adult children fell from 39% in 2023 to 22% in 2026.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: Bay Alarm Medical and Medical Guardian lead the category in 2026 reviews, with smartwatch-style devices gaining share. The medical alert market is now roughly $4.8 billion and growing 10.5% annually.

recommendations.title: Audit conversion tracking before spending more
recommendations.detail: Two leads on 1,797 clicks suggests tracking is broken. Consider verifying phone call tracking, form submissions, and pixel firing before increasing budget on this campaign.

recommendations.title: Test a simpler landing page for the 45-65+ audience
recommendations.detail: Only 138 of 1,797 clicks reached the landing page view event. Worth exploring a stripped-down page with a large phone number and a single call-to-action.

recommendations.title: Consider shifting budget toward direction and call assets
recommendations.detail: Direction requests (103) outperformed call clicks (1) this period. Test call extensions, location extensions, and click-to-call ads to match how prospects actually engage.
